story_body_1: We didn't want our wedding to be ordinary. Or forgettable. So decor picked off a shelf was never on the cards.
story_body_2: People noticed. People talked. So now we want to do it for everyone.
story_body_3: [A few lines on what happened next: how the wedding turned into Alterbloom.]
portrait_alt: An illustration of the two of us in white shirts and flower garlands, with giant coral and peach paper poppies behind

band.alt: The two grooms dancing forehead to forehead in white shirts and rust trousers, one hand patterned with henna

values.title: Nothing off a shelf.
values.body: If you have seen it at someone else's wedding, it isn't yours. The big pieces are made by hand, for your day.

values.title: Decor and a show.
values.body: How it looks is half of it. We plan who is on the mic and what happens on the dance floor too.

values.title: Your way, your day.
values.body: No rulebook and no assumptions about who is getting married or how. Tell us what matters and we build around it.

cta_body: Tell us the date, the place and the one thing your guests must remember.
